newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE may turn lower from 3,955 resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE may turn lower from 3,955 resistance.

text.p: An awkwardly-poised London stock market will try to make headway on Monday but technical analysts doubt its capacity to make a great leap forward.
Much of the nervousness from early last week may have gone but investor confidence was insufficient at present to carry the FTSE 100 index too high, they added.
"The market is trying to find its form and will probably meet up with resistance at 3,955 to 3,960 from which point it could turn a little lower," said Peter Frey, an independent consultant.
By 0719 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 1.0 at 3,947.4.
Most short-term momentum indicators for the FTSE are currently held at neutral levels, Frey said.
"The market needs to spend some time building a base from which it can move higher with confidence," he said.
"A small dip now will allow momentum indicators to give more optimistic readings in order to rejoin the market's main uptrend (since August)," he added.

According to Frey, the problem with any immediate bounce by the market would be the lack of impetus, meaning the FTSE would backtrack a little and the market would achieve very little over the short term.
